prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a large beautifully composed overhead photograph of a collection of TWELVE DIFFERENT original Flixie After Hours die-cut vinyl sticker designs, each completely visible and separated with generous space, arranged on warm bone paper. Premium independent cinema club / fashion brand art direction. Reference 1 is the exact approved rounded F symbol with separate lower-right bar; preserve geometry. Reference 2 is the existing original Flixie wordmark; do not invent replacement lettering. Use original typography graphics, no film IP. Palette core purple #7C4DFF, lilac #B9A0FF, midnight #120A24, bone #F3F0E9, supporting mint #65D6C4 and peach #F1A77A. Mostly matte finish; realistic subtle sticker thickness and paper shadows. All typography readable, correct spelling, no extra slogans or captions. Twelve stickers:
1 large bone rounded rectangle, editorial elegant serif text exactly 'Good films. Better company.' arranged on three lines, tiny lilac F bottom right.
2 midnight oval with bone elegant serif text exactly 'Stay for the credits.' and tiny lilac bar.
3 lilac die-cut isolated exact F with narrow bone contour border.
4 mint circle containing exact midnight F and small 'AFTER HOURS' sans serif below.
5 peach horizontal bumper sticker with bold midnight sans serif exactly 'GOOD FILMS. BETTER COMPANY.'
6 midnight rounded rectangle with lilac bold sans serif stacked 'STAY FOR / THE CREDITS.' and tiny bone F.
7 bone circle with purple original F centred and 'AFTER HOURS' simple small sans serif beneath.
8 lilac square with bold midnight type 'GOOD FILMS.' at top and 'BETTER COMPANY.' below, no extra illustration.
9 bone custom contour die-cut elegant serif words 'Stay for the credits.' midnight, peach little horizontal bar.
10 purple long narrow rectangle with white sans serif 'Good films. Better company.' and tiny bone F on right.
11 midnight small rectangle with the ORIGINAL Flixie wordmark from reference2 accurately applied.
12 bone elongated oval with midnight 'AFTER HOURS' and tiny purple F.
Avoid generic cinema clip art, reels, popcorn, play buttons, fake dates, QR codes, glitter, glossy gradients, movie characters, random text, additional slogans. This is a concept mockup of real wearable-brand merchandise, not a UI. Header outside stickers small 'Flixie / After Hours sticker collection', footer 'CONCEPT MOCKUPS'. Landscape high resolution composition, twelve truly distinct layouts, not the same logo on everything.
